```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
```

# Load libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(sleuth)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Load sample metadata
```{r}
s2c <- read_csv(here("Raw","results","run_metadata.txt")) %>% 
  mutate(path = gsub("/abundance.tsv", "", paste0(here("Raw","results"), "/", path)),
         name = gsub("_0h_\\d$", "", name),
         sample = paste0(name, "_",  timepoint, "_", biorep),
         name = factor(name),
         timepoint = factor(timepoint),
         biorep = factor(biorep)
         ) 

s2c <- s2c %>%
  mutate(
    experiment = if_else(name %in% c("pmk1", "Guy11M"), "Exp2", "Exp1"),
    experiment = factor(experiment, levels = c("Exp1", "Exp2"))
  )
```

# Helper function
```{r}
do_DGE_one <- function(s2c_tp, control, condition_label,
                       t2g = NULL,
                       aggregation_column = NULL,
                       out_dir = "Analysis/Data/DGE") {
  s2c_tp <- s2c_tp %>%
    mutate(name = droplevels(factor(name))) %>%
    mutate(name = relevel(name, ref = control))
  
  message("      Running: ", condition_label, " vs ", control)
  
  # Try-catch to provide better error messages
  so <- tryCatch({
    sleuth_prep(
      s2c_tp,
      ~ name,
      target_mapping = t2g,
      aggregation_column = aggregation_column,
      transformation_function = function(x) log2(x + 0.5),
      num_cores = 1,
      read_bootstrap_tpm = FALSE,
      extra_bootstrap_summary = FALSE  # Reduce file access further
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error in sleuth_prep: ", e$message)
    message("Attempting to clean up and retry...")
    gc()
    closeAllConnections()
    Sys.sleep(1)
    
    # Retry once
    sleuth_prep(
      s2c_tp,
      ~ name,
      target_mapping = t2g,
      aggregation_column = aggregation_column,
      transformation_function = function(x) log2(x + 0.5),
      num_cores = 1,
      read_bootstrap_tpm = FALSE,
      extra_bootstrap_summary = FALSE
    )
  })
  
  so <- sleuth_fit(so, ~ name, 'full')
  so <- sleuth_fit(so, ~ 1, 'reduced')
  so <- sleuth_lrt(so, 'reduced', 'full')
  
  coef_name <- paste0("name", condition_label)
  so <- sleuth_wt(so, coef_name)
  res <- sleuth_results(so, coef_name, 'wt')
  
  tp_str <- as.character(unique(s2c_tp$timepoint))
  exp_str <- as.character(unique(s2c_tp$experiment))
  
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  out_file <- file.path(out_dir,
                        paste0("sleuth_", exp_str, "_", tp_str, "H_",
                               condition_label, "_vs_", control, ".csv"))
  write_csv(res, out_file)
  
  # Force cleanup
  rm(so)
  gc()
  closeAllConnections()
  Sys.sleep(1)  # Increased pause
  
  return(res)
}
```

# Run full experiment
```{r}
run_experiment <- function(s2c_all,
                           experiment_label,
                           control_name,
                           exclude_from_tests = character(),
                           t2g = NULL,
                           aggregation_column = NULL,
                           out_dir = "Analysis/Data/DGE") {

  message(">> Running ", experiment_label, "   (control = ", control_name, ")")

  s2c_exp <- s2c_all %>%
    filter(experiment == experiment_label) %>%
    droplevels()

  stopifnot(control_name %in% s2c_exp$name)

  conditions <- setdiff(levels(droplevels(s2c_exp$name)),
                        c(control_name, exclude_from_tests))

  if (length(conditions) == 0) {
    warning("No conditions remain for ", experiment_label)
    return(NULL)
  }

  for (tp in levels(s2c_exp$timepoint)) {

    message("   Timepoint: ", tp, "H")
    s2c_tp <- s2c_exp %>% filter(timepoint == tp)

    if (nrow(s2c_tp) == 0) next
    if (!(control_name %in% s2c_tp$name)) {
      message("    Control not present at this timepoint -- skipped.")
      next
    }

    for (nm in conditions) {
      if (nm %in% s2c_tp$name) {
        do_DGE_one(s2c_tp,
                   control = control_name,
                   condition_label = nm,
                   t2g = t2g,
                   aggregation_column = aggregation_column,
                   out_dir = out_dir)
      }
    }
    
    # Clean up after each timepoint to release file handles
    gc()
    closeAllConnections()
    Sys.sleep(1)  # Increased pause
  }
  
  # Final cleanup after experiment
  gc()
  closeAllConnections()
  message(">> Completed ", experiment_label)
}
```

# Optional t2g
```{r}
t2g <- NULL
aggregation_column <- NULL
```

```{r cross experiment helper}
# Cross-experiment comparison: condition A (in exp_A) vs condition B (in exp_B),
# adjusting for experiment as a covariate.
run_cross_experiment <- function(s2c_all,
                                 cond_A, exp_A,          # e.g., "pmk1", "Exp2"  (treated as control)
                                 cond_B, exp_B,          # e.g., "mst7", "Exp1"
                                 t2g = NULL,
                                 aggregation_column = NULL,
                                 out_dir = "Analysis/Data/DGE") {
  message(">> Cross-experiment: ", cond_B, " (", exp_B, ") vs ", cond_A, " (", exp_A, ")")

  # Subset to only the two conditions and their specified experiments
  s2c_sub <- s2c_all %>%
    filter((name == cond_A & experiment == exp_A) |
           (name == cond_B & experiment == exp_B)) %>%
    droplevels()

  if (nrow(s2c_sub) == 0) {
    warning("No samples found for the requested cross-experiment comparison.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Timepoints present in BOTH groups
  tps_A <- s2c_sub %>% filter(name == cond_A) %>% pull(timepoint) %>% unique() %>% as.character()
  tps_B <- s2c_sub %>% filter(name == cond_B) %>% pull(timepoint) %>% unique() %>% as.character()
  common_tps <- intersect(tps_A, tps_B)

  if (length(common_tps) == 0) {
    warning("No shared timepoints between ", cond_A, " (", exp_A, ") and ", cond_B, " (", exp_B, ").")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  for (tp in common_tps) {
    message("   Timepoint: ", tp, "H")

    s2c_tp <- s2c_sub %>% filter(timepoint == tp) %>% droplevels()

    # Basic checks (at least 1 sample per group; ideally >= 2)
    n_A <- sum(s2c_tp$name == cond_A)
    n_B <- sum(s2c_tp$name == cond_B)
    if (n_A == 0 || n_B == 0) {
      message("    Skipping ", tp, "H: missing one of the groups (", cond_A, " n=", n_A, "; ", cond_B, " n=", n_B, ").")
      next
    }
    if (n_A < 2 || n_B < 2) {
      warning("    Warning at ", tp, "H: low replicates (", cond_A, " n=", n_A, "; ", cond_B, " n=", n_B, "). Results may be unstable.")
    }

    # Relevel condition; keep only these two levels
    s2c_tp <- s2c_tp %>%
      mutate(
        name = factor(as.character(name), levels = c(cond_A, cond_B)),
        experiment = droplevels(factor(experiment))
      )

    # Prep with batch adjustment (~ name + experiment)
    message("      Running: ", cond_B, " vs ", cond_A, "  (adjusting for experiment)")
    so <- tryCatch({
      sleuth_prep(
        s2c_tp,
        ~ name + experiment,
        target_mapping = t2g,
        aggregation_column = aggregation_column,
        transformation_function = function(x) log2(x + 0.5),
        num_cores = 1,
        read_bootstrap_tpm = FALSE,
        extra_bootstrap_summary = FALSE
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Error in sleuth_prep: ", e$message)
      message("Attempting to clean up and retry...")
      gc()
      closeAllConnections()
      Sys.sleep(1)
      sleuth_prep(
        s2c_tp,
        ~ name + experiment,
        target_mapping = t2g,
        aggregation_column = aggregation_column,
        transformation_function = function(x) log2(x + 0.5),
        num_cores = 1,
        read_bootstrap_tpm = FALSE,
        extra_bootstrap_summary = FALSE
      )
    })

    # Fit and test the condition coefficient (namecond_B)
    so <- sleuth_fit(so, ~ name + experiment, 'full')
    so <- sleuth_fit(so, ~ experiment, 'reduced')  # drop the 'name' effect for LRT if you want LRT too
    so <- sleuth_lrt(so, 'reduced', 'full')

    coef_name <- paste0("name", cond_B)
    so <- sleuth_wt(so, coef_name)
    res <- sleuth_results(so, coef_name, 'wt')

    out_file <- file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0("sleuth_CrossExp_", tp, "H_", cond_B, "_vs_", cond_A, "__", exp_B, "_vs_", exp_A, ".csv")
    )
    write_csv(res, out_file)

    # Cleanup
    rm(so); gc(); closeAllConnections(); Sys.sleep(1)
  }

  gc(); closeAllConnections()
  message(">> Completed cross-experiment: ", cond_B, " (", exp_B, ") vs ", cond_A, " (", exp_A, ")")
}

```

# Run analyses within each experiment
```{r}
#All Exp1 against Guy11
run_experiment(s2c,
               experiment_label = "Exp1",
               control_name = "Guy11",
               exclude_from_tests = c("Guy11M"))

# Additional cleanup between experiments
gc()
closeAllConnections()
Sys.sleep(2)


#All Exp1 against MST7WT
run_experiment(s2c,
               experiment_label = "Exp1",
               control_name = "MST7WT",
               exclude_from_tests = c("Guy11M"))

# Additional cleanup between experiments
gc()
closeAllConnections()
Sys.sleep(2)

#All Exp1 against mst7
run_experiment(s2c,
               experiment_label = "Exp1",
               control_name = "mst7",
               exclude_from_tests = c("Guy11M"))

# Additional cleanup between experiments
gc()
closeAllConnections()
Sys.sleep(2)

#All Exp1 against MST7PM
run_experiment(s2c,
               experiment_label = "Exp1",
               control_name = "MST7PM",
               exclude_from_tests = c("Guy11M"))

# Additional cleanup between experiments
gc()
closeAllConnections()
Sys.sleep(2)

#All Exp1 against MST7PD
run_experiment(s2c,
               experiment_label = "Exp1",
               control_name = "MST7PD",
               exclude_from_tests = c("Guy11M"))

# Additional cleanup between experiments
gc()
closeAllConnections()
Sys.sleep(2)

#All Exp2 against Guy11M
run_experiment(s2c,
               experiment_label = "Exp2",
               control_name = "Guy11M",
               exclude_from_tests = character())


```

```{r cross experiment runs}
# -------- Cross-experiment comparisons (adjust for experiment as covariate) --------
# pmk1 (Exp2) vs MST7PM (Exp1)
run_cross_experiment(
  s2c_all = s2c,
  cond_A = "pmk1",  exp_A = "Exp2",   # treated as control/reference
  cond_B = "mst7", exp_B = "Exp1",
  t2g = t2g,
  aggregation_column = aggregation_column,
  out_dir = "Analysis/Data/DGE"
)
```
